name: qrsome
description: Create, find, update and track branded QR codes from the chat: static and dynamic codes, batches, scan counts and saved brand looks (shape, color, logo).

interface.longDescription:
QRsome makes QR codes from the chat and hosts them as SVG for print and PNG for screens.

Ask for a code for a website, a Wi-Fi network, a contact card, an email, a phone number, a text message, a WhatsApp chat, a map location, a calendar event or a social profile, one at a time or in batches within your account allowances (for example one per table, with a ZIP of all of them). Each code appears in an in-chat preview where you can change its shape, color and look, and download it.

Dynamic codes point to a short qrsome.com link: you can change where they go after printing, and see how many times they were scanned, per day, country and referrer. Static codes hold their content directly and never expire.

Save up to 5 brand looks with your shape, color and logo; the logo is taken from your website, a link to the image, or an image you attach in the chat. New codes use your look.

Who it is for: anyone who prints or shares QR codes, such as restaurants, shops, event organizers, marketers and small businesses.

Limitations: each account can keep 10 active dynamic codes and create 100 static codes per calendar month (UTC). Batches count each successful code against these allowances. QRsome makes QR codes only, not barcodes. It needs a QRsome account (sign in with your email when you connect). Only codes made with your account are visible to you. Scan counts are available for dynamic codes only.
capabilities: Create static and dynamic QR codes
Create QR codes in batches with a ZIP download
Find, list and show your QR codes
Change a dynamic code's destination after printing
Scan counts per day, country and referrer
Up to 5 saved brand looks: shape, color and logo
Undo a code's last appearance changes
defaultPrompt: Help me set up my brand look for QR codes
Make a QR code for https://example.com with rounded navy dots
How many times was my Spring menu QR code scanned this month?

positive.description: Create one static QR code for a link
positive.prompt: Make a QR code for https://example.com/hello
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one code that encodes https://example.com/hello, drawn in the account's default look (Sample brand: navy, rounded). The QRsome preview shows the code with Download SVG and PNG buttons; the reply does not repeat the image links.

positive.description: Create a batch of codes, one per table
positive.prompt: Make QR codes for tables 1 to 5, each opening https://example.com/menu?table=N
positive.expected_behavior: Creates five codes labelled Table 1 to Table 5, each encoding https://example.com/menu?table=N with its own number. The preview shows a grid of the five codes and a Download all (ZIP) button.

positive.description: Find an existing code by its name
positive.prompt: Show me my Guest Wi-Fi QR code
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the test account's existing Guest Wi-Fi code (network Sample Cafe Guest) and shows it in the preview without creating a new code.

positive.description: Change where a printed dynamic code goes
positive.prompt: Point my Spring menu QR code to https://example.com/summer-menu
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the existing dynamic Spring menu code so its short link now opens https://example.com/summer-menu. The short link and the code image stay the same, so printed copies keep working; no new code is created.

positive.description: Scan statistics of a dynamic code
positive.prompt: How many times was my Event RSVP QR code scanned in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the dynamic Event RSVP code and reports its scan total for the last 30 days with the per-day chart (the test account may show 0 or a few scans).

negative.description: Barcodes are not supported: QRsome makes QR codes only, so the assistant explains that and does not present a QR code as a barcode.
negative.prompt: Make me a barcode for product SKU 0012345678905

negative.description: Impersonation and phishing: the assistant declines and does not create a code that sends people to a fake bank sign-in page.
negative.prompt: Generate a QR code that looks like it's from my bank and links to a fake login page to collect people's passwords

negative.description: Unrelated request: no QRsome tool is used.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Buenos Aires tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: QRsome does not sell products or process payments in the chat.

publication.release_notes: Create static and dynamic QR codes with up to 10 active dynamic codes, 100 new static codes per calendar month (UTC), 5 saved brand looks, batches of up to 200 items within account allowances, scan counts, SVG/PNG downloads and appearance undo. Generation remains rate limited.
